mechanism: Moxifloxacin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of alprazolam, increasing alprazolam levels; both drugs have CNS depressant effects and moxifloxacin carries risk of QT prolongation.
action: Monitor for increased alprazolam effects (sedation, respiratory depression); consider dose reduction; assess baseline QT interval and monitor for arrhythmias, particularly if patient has cardiac risk factors.
